items.headline: Bitget Hot Wallet Breach Hits $351M, $BGB in Focus
items.summary: Bitget suspended withdrawals after a $351.6M hot wallet breach across four chains. Cold wallets are safe and a $464M protection fund covers losses, but $BGB traders are on edge.

items.headline: Paxos Labs Launches $PAXGy: Yield-Bearing Tokenized Gold
items.summary: Paxos Labs unveiled $PAXGy, adding lending yield to tokenized gold $PAXG. Holders take borrower-default risk, with redemptions via an approval-gated queue.

items.headline: KelpDAO Sues LayerZero, $ZRO CEO Calls Claim 'Meritless'
items.summary: KelpDAO filed a BC civil claim against LayerZero, with CEO Bryan Pellegrino also named. He vows to fight the 'meritless' suit as $ZRO watches the fallout.

items.headline: $FLOKI Now Collateral on Morpho, API3 Confirms
items.summary: API3 says $FLOKI collateralization is live on Morpho, letting holders borrow against the memecoin. A fresh DeFi use case for the dog-themed token.

items.headline: Kamino Opens GPU-Backed $sUSDai Market on Solana
items.summary: Kamino launched an Allez Labs-curated market letting $sUSDai holders borrow USDC at up to 80% LTV. GPU-loan-linked collateral brings AI yield to Solana DeFi.
